mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate revenues, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 200.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in residential construction starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong underlying demand for goods and services, which increases corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 105.0 for two consecutive months signals weakening supply chain activity and declining corporate output, which reduces earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 105.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 1.0% combined with a CPI reading above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS > 1.0 and CPIAUCSL > 2.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction term's Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 6.5% and decline in non-farm payrolls below 136,000 signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer confidence and spending, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE > 6.5 and PAYEMS < 136000.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction term's Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 360,000 million dollars combined with a drop in housing starts below 800,000 units signals weakening demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS < 360000.0 and HOUST < 800.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction term's Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 108.0 for two consecutive months signals strong supply-side momentum, improving corporate output and margins, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO exceeds 108.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
